framework._comment: The assessment framework the whole pipeline reads. SOURCES: the six descriptors, and the two metrics under each of the first five with their wording, are Football Australia's own - from the '5Ps Descriptors' slide reproduced in FIFA's Talent Identification Guide (p.44-45, 'How Australia use player profiles to identify talent and educate coaches'). The same slide shows each metric rated on a 0-5 axis and profiled as PLAYER / BENCHMARK / BEST. NOT PUBLISHED, so assumed here and marked 'assumed': the two metrics under Presence (the sixth P was added later), the anchors of the 1-5 scale, and the behaviours in the seven position profiles. The potential scale and the observed-maturation field are FIFA's (long and short player observation tools, p.86-90). Replacing any assumption is an edit to this file, not to the code.

scale.3: Shows it regularly at this level
scale.4: Shows it consistently, including against strong opposition
scale.5: Stands out for it in a national-level environment

framework.scale_note: Football Australia's slide shows a 0-5 axis with the benchmark near 3. The anchors are assumed, and assumed to describe behaviour rather than age: that is what lets a rating rise as a player improves.

recommendation_meaning.Short-term: ready for a national-team look now

position_aliases._comment: Other ways people write a position, mapped onto the seven above. Only unambiguous ones: 'CM' could be a 6 or an 8, so it is left out and a person is asked.

pressure.label: Pressure
pressure.meaning: Winning the ball back: aggressive intent, communication, and reading the cues to press.

metrics.label: Intent
metrics.description: Shows aggressive intent and communicates effectively
metrics.work_on: Start the press earlier and louder: first step on the trigger, call the next player across

metrics.label: Decisions
metrics.description: Understands cues and makes decisions in relation to others' actions
metrics.short: Reads the cues; presses at the right moment
metrics.work_on: Pick the moment: press a bad touch or a backward pass; hold when the ball can go long

protection.label: Protection
protection.meaning: Defending our goal: understanding how to protect the box, and the habits that do it.

metrics.label: Understanding
metrics.description: Understands how to protect our box and back third
metrics.short: Knows how to protect the box
metrics.work_on: Protect the box first: body between ball and goal, screen the central lane

metrics.label: Habits
metrics.description: Shows good defensive habits: delay, make the opponent predictable, marking, blocking shots and crosses
metrics.work_on: Delay rather than dive in; show the attacker one way; block the cross with the near foot

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.meaning: Being in the right place: reading play and getting back into shape without the ball; being an option to go forward with it.
positioning.game: reading the game and being in the right place

metrics.label: BPO – Awareness
metrics.description: Reads play well; manages transition and gets into shape quickly when the opponent has the ball
metrics.work_on: React on the turnover: three recovery steps before looking for the ball; scan before receiving

metrics.label: BP – Positive
metrics.description: Positioned to attack: always wants to affect the play and be an option to go forward
metrics.short: Positioned to attack; an option forward
metrics.work_on: Move early to offer a forward option; arrive in the box rather than wait in it

possession.label: Possession
possession.meaning: Keeping the ball with purpose: intelligent decisions for the flow of the game, and bravery without waste.

metrics.label: Intelligence
metrics.description: Shows intelligence when making decisions with the ball in relation to the flow and control of the game
metrics.work_on: Choose the pass that keeps the team's shape; forward when it is on, keep it when it is not

metrics.label: Brave with the ball
metrics.description: Is brave with choices without being wasteful or casual
metrics.work_on: Take the forward pass under pressure; one touch fewer; no casual giveaways

penetration.label: Penetration
penetration.meaning: Hurting the opponent: seeing and playing what breaks the defence, and the intent to score.

metrics.label: Purpose
metrics.description: Sees, plays and executes options that penetrate the defence
metrics.work_on: Look for the pass or run that breaks the line before the safe one

metrics.label: Positive
metrics.work_on: Shoot when the chance is on; attack the second ball in the box

presence.label: Presence
presence.meaning: Influence on the game and on team-mates. The sixth P was added after the others; its two metrics are not published and are assumed here.
presence.game: influence on the game and on team-mates

metrics.label: Influence
metrics.description: Lifts and organises the players around them
metrics.work_on: Organise before the ball arrives; talk the line into position

metrics.label: Resilience
metrics.description: Responds to setbacks and keeps competing
metrics.work_on: Next action straight after a mistake; keep the work rate after conceding

presence.short: Influence on the game and team-mates (assumed)

cadence_days._comment: How often a player at each level of the ladder should be looked at: a national-camp player quarterly, a TDS or championships player every four months, a club-level player every eight months. A player past this is 'due a look' on the watch list; an injured player is not counted as overdue while out. Assumed; the scheme's own cadence replaces it.

framework._injury_major: A major injury is one of 12 weeks or more out, or a concussion whatever the weeks (a head injury is a flag at any length). Two or more injuries, or 16 weeks out, in two years is 'repeatedly injured'.
